output.name: mem_read
output.description: Read a note from Obsidian-Memory by ID, permalink, or search query. Returns the full note content with metadata. Use this to retrieve specific notes when you know their identifier or want to find notes by searching.

query.description: Search query to find note (returns first match)

vault.description: Optional vault name to filter search

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: mem_write
output.description: Create or update a note in Obsidian-Memory. If note_id is provided, updates the existing note; otherwise creates a new note. Use this to save important information, decisions, patterns, or knowledge for future reference.

note_id.description: Note ID for update (omit for create)

vault_name.description: Vault name (optional, uses default if not provided)

output.name: mem_search
output.description: Search notes in Obsidian-Memory using full-text search with optional filters. Supports FTS5 syntax (terms, phrases, boolean operators). Returns matching notes with snippets and pagination metadata.

query.description: Search query (FTS5 syntax: terms, phrases, boolean operators)

tags.description: Filter by tags (AND - all must match)

tags_any.description: Filter by tags (OR - any can match)

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: build_context
output.description: Build context from memory:// URI patterns. Supports note selection by ID, permalink, search, path, tags, project, and graph operations. Use this to gather related notes into a single context block.

uris.description: Array of memory:// URI patterns. Examples: "memory://note/123", "memory://search/auth", "memory://tags/security,backend", "memory://project/api"

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: graph_traverse
output.description: Traverse the knowledge graph from a starting note using BFS or DFS. Returns visited nodes and optional paths. Note: Currently uses search-based approximation while graph API is being implemented.

target_node_id.description: Optional target node ID (stops when found)

exclude_nodes.description: Node IDs to exclude from traversal

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: graph_similar
output.description: Find notes similar to a given note using graph structure and content similarity. Note: Currently uses search-based approximation while graph API is being implemented.

limit.description: Maximum similar notes to return (1-100, default: 10)

method.description: Similarity method: graph, content, or hybrid

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: project_list
output.description: List all projects with their note counts. Returns projects sorted by note count (descending). Use this to discover available projects in the knowledge base.

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: project_switch
output.description: Switch to a project context. Returns project details and recent notes. This is informational - actual project filtering happens in other tools via the project parameter.

project_name.description: Name of the project to switch to

limit.description: Number of recent notes to return (default: 10)

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: project_create
output.description: Create a new project. Projects are created implicitly when notes are added with a project field, but this tool allows explicit creation with name validation.

project_name.description: Name of the project to create (alphanumeric, dash, underscore only)

output.name: session_observe
output.description: Add an observation or event to a session. Use this to track decisions, errors, solutions, tool usage, file edits, commands, and other significant events during a development session.

session_id.description: Session ID (create one first if needed)

metadata.description: Optional metadata (e.g., file path, command, tool name)

output.name: session_summary
output.description: Generate an AI summary of a session. Extracts key learnings, decisions made, errors encountered, solutions found, and next steps from the session events.

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text

output.name: session_context
output.description: Get context for a session including events and summary. Useful for loading session context into Claude to continue work or review what happened in a previous session.

include_summary.description: Include AI summary if available (default: true)

response_format.description: Response format: "json" for structured data, "markdown" for human-readable text
